title: 回答的结构
goal: 按问题范围组织直接回答、理由、细节和收尾，并识别偏题与遗漏。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断第一句是否直接回答了问题

cards.title: 结构
rows: 直接回答
第一句给出所问的信息或立场，不重复题目。
I prefer the smaller seminar.
理由
说明为什么这样选。
It gives each participant more time to speak.
例子
用一件具体的事说明理由。
Last week, everyone presented an interpretation of the poem.
细节
说明过程、条件或结果，和理由相连。
We compared the interpretations before choosing one.
收尾
回到答案，不再加新的理由。
That discussion is why the smaller format suits me.
事实类回答
问的是事实时，回答可以短，不加观点。
Where does the seminar meet? → In the language center.
观点类回答
通常需要更多解释。
Should it stay small? → Yes, because everyone can contribute.
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 事实
I usually …，说明习惯。
I usually prepare a list of questions.
立场
I prefer … / I think …，后接明确的选择或判断。
I think short meetings are more productive.
理由
The main reason is that …，that 后接完整的句子。
The main reason is that everyone arrives prepared.
例子
For example, …，例子要支持前面的理由。
For example, we settled the budget in one meeting.
细节
More specifically, …，把内容说得更具体。
More specifically, we compared the two largest expenses.
结果
As a result, …，引出前面过程带来的结果。
As a result, we finished before the room closed.
收尾
That's why …，指前面已经说过的理由。
That's why I favor a written agenda.

body.box:
Question: Would a shared herb garden benefit the residence hall? Why?
Response: I think it would. Residents could meet while caring for it. For example, students on different floors could take turns watering the plants together. That shared task would give them a reason to talk.

body.p: I think it would 先回答是否有益。could meet 给出社交理由，take turns watering 说明怎样实现。最后一句回到交流的机会，没有加新的理由。

body.box:
Which sentence directly answers the question?
1. Some residents grow herbs in their rooms.
2. The residence hall has an unused courtyard.
3. I think a shared garden would help residents connect.
4. Watering a garden takes regular effort.

body.p: 第三项明确说有益，并点出作用。其余三句可以作背景或细节，但没有回答是否有益。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 先述背景
Should tours be smaller? → Tours take place on weekends.
I favor smaller tours. 先给立场。
只答一半
Where and why? → In the courtyard.
In the courtyard, because it has space. 补原因。
理由循环
I prefer it because it is my preference.
I prefer it because it reduces waiting. 说明作用。
例子偏题
Quiet rooms aid focus. For example, the chairs are blue.
Quiet rooms aid focus. I can read without interruptions.
收尾加新理由
So it saves time. It is also cheaper.
So it saves time. 成本要另作说明。
事实过度展开
Where is it? → I believe locations matter.
It is beside the entrance. 先交代地点。

groups.text: Question: How often does the film club meet? Notes: twice a month; in a lecture room; student-led; founded last autumn.

items.stem: Which opening directly answers the question?
options: It is run by students.
It meets twice monthly.
It meets in a lecture room.
It began last autumn.
items.why: How often 问频率，notes 里是 twice a month，第二项的 twice monthly 与之对应。

groups.text: Question: Why did the speaker choose the pottery class? Notes: wanted to learn hand-building; class meets on Tuesday; teacher makes large bowls; materials included.

items.stem: Which opening states the requested reason?
options: The teacher makes large bowls by hand.
The fee for the class includes the materials.
I wanted to learn to shape clay by hand.
The class meets on Tuesdays each week.
items.why: Why 问原因，notes 里是 wanted to learn hand-building，第三项是它的同义改写。

groups.text: Claim: A meal rota reduces uncertainty. Detail: Each flatmate knows which evening to cook.

items.stem: How should the detail relate to the claim?
options: It should show how the rota makes duties clear.
It should replace the claim with a list of meals.
It should contradict the idea of assigned evenings.
It should name the meal each flatmate cooks.
items.why: Each flatmate knows which evening to cook 说明了 reduces uncertainty 的具体表现，即第一项。

groups.text: Question: Which exhibition was memorable, and what made it memorable? Response: The textile exhibition was memorable.

items.stem: What must be added to complete the answer?
options: Another statement that the exhibition was memorable
A comparison with every other exhibition
The name of the textile exhibition again
The feature that made the textiles stand out
items.why: 回答只说了哪个展览难忘，还缺 what made it memorable，即第四项。

groups.text: Question: Should the student radio station keep its local-history program? Response: Yes, it gives residents a chance to share experiences. Last month, a retired bus driver described how routes changed around the old depot. Listeners then sent in photographs of the same area. The program makes those personal memories available to others.

items.stem: What is the role of the bus driver's account?
options: It replaces the speaker's positive position with a story.
It gives an example of residents sharing experiences.
It introduces a different program about transport.
It explains why listeners sent in photographs.
items.why: a retired bus driver described … 是 residents share experiences 的一个例子，即第二项。

items.stem: Which opening preserves the answer's directness?
options: I used to listen to many different stations.
The old depot is near several bus routes.
The station should retain the program because it shares local memories.
There are photographs of the depot in the station.
items.why: Should … keep 问是否保留。第三项用 retain the program 直接回答，并接上后文的 personal memories。
makes … available 说明节目的作用，those personal memories 指前面的例子。

lines.text: I prefer repairing clothes to replacing them. One reason is that a small repair lets me keep an item that already fits.

items.stem: The question asks whether the speaker prefers repairing or replacing clothes. Which opening is direct?
options: I prefer keeping clothes usable through repairs.
Some of my clothes no longer fit well.
Small repairs need thread and a needle.
I bought several replacement items recently.
items.why: 录音第一句 I prefer repairing clothes to replacing them 直接作出选择，第一项是它的同义改写。

items.stem: What does the second sentence contribute?
options: A new preference that contradicts the opening
A reason supporting the preference for repairs
A closing remark about a different activity
A list of all clothing repair techniques
items.why: One reason is that 引出支持修补衣服的理由，即第二项。

items.stem: Rebuild the first sentence that was heard.
items.why: prefer … to … 表示比起后者更喜欢前者。这里的 to 是介词，不用 than。

items.stem: Rebuild the second sentence that was heard.
items.why: One reason is that 后接完整的句子，说明理由。

lines.text: The sketching group meets beside the canal. We use that spot because the path provides a clear view of the warehouses.

items.stem: The interviewer asks where the group meets. Which opening supplies that information?
options: The group enjoys sketching old warehouses.
A clear view is useful for outdoor sketching.
The meeting spot is next to the canal.
The path can be busy during the afternoon.
items.why: meets beside the canal 回答了 where，第三项的 next to 是 beside 的同义改写。

items.stem: If the interviewer also asks why that spot was chosen, how does the response develop?
options: It gives the time of the meeting after naming the location.
It replaces the location with a description of the group.
It repeats the canal's name without giving a reason.
It connects the chosen location with a useful view.
items.why: because the path provides a clear view 说明了选这个地点的原因，即第四项。

items.stem: Rebuild the first sentence that was heard.
items.why: meets beside the canal 先交代地点。

items.stem: Rebuild the second sentence that was heard.
chunks: a clear view of the warehouses
items.why: because 引出选这个地点的理由，that spot 指前一句的运河边。
